pages.markdown: # CD50 / ICAM-3 Antibody, Mouse MAb Catalog Number: 10333-MM02 Flow cytometric analysis of human ICAM3(CD50) expression on human peripheral blood lymphocytes. Cells were stained with purified anti-Human ICAM3(CD50), then a FITC-conjugated second step antibody. The histogram were derived from events with the forward and side light-scatter characteristics of viable lymphocytes. Flow cytometry was performed on a BD FACSCalibur flow cytometry system. Please refer to www.sinobiological.com/Flow- Cytometry-FACS-Protocols-a-750.html for technical protocols. Manufactured By Sino Biological Inc., FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. NOT FOR USE IN HUMANS. The logo for Sino Biological features a circular icon containing the letters 'SB' in white over a teal background, with a small blue sphere at the bottom. To the right of the icon is the text 'Sino Biological' in a dark font, with the tagline 'Biological Solution Specialist' in a smaller, grey font below it.


Catalog Number: 10333-MM02


Relative Cell Number

10º 101 102 103 104 Purified ICAM3(CD50), with isotype control (FITC second step)
This is a flow cytometry histogram comparing two cell populations. The X-axis represents the intensity of 'Purified ICAM3(CD50), with isotype control (FITC second step)' on a logarithmic scale from 10^0 to 10^4, while the Y-axis represents 'Relative Cell Number'. The chart compares a gray-shaded distribution (isotype control) with a black-outlined distribution (ICAM3/CD50), showing a clear rightward shift for the ICAM3/CD50 sample, indicating positive expression.


Flow cytometric analysis of human ICAM3(CD50) expression on human peripheral blood lymphocytes. Cells were stained with purified anti-Human ICAM3(CD50), then a FITC-conjugated second step antibody. The histogram were derived from events with the forward and side light-scatter characteristics of viable lymphocytes.

Flow cytometry was performed on a BD FACSCalibur flow cytometry system. Please refer to www.sinobiological.com/Flow- Cytometry-FACS-Protocols-a-750.html for technical protocols.
